sql_templates.sql:
WITH latest_flows AS (
    SELECT trade_date, fii_net_today, dii_net_today, flow_signal
    FROM signals.fii_dii_flows
    WHERE trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM signals.fii_dii_flows)
),
latest_regime AS (
    SELECT trade_date, regime
    FROM signals.regime_history
    WHERE trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM signals.regime_history)
),
latest_breadth AS (
    SELECT trade_date, ad_signal, market_sentiment
    FROM breadth.market_daily
    WHERE trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM breadth.market_daily)
),
latest_index AS (
    SELECT trade_date, close, trading_signal
    FROM market.index_eod
    WHERE trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market.index_eod)
)
SELECT *
FROM latest_flows lf
JOIN latest_regime lr ON lf.trade_date = lr.trade_date
JOIN latest_breadth lb ON lf.trade_date = lb.trade_date
JOIN latest_index li ON lf.trade_date = li.trade_date;

sql_templates.description: Latest sector breadth analysis with Stage 2 participation
sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_breadth AS (
  SELECT sector, pct_above_50dma, change_5d
  FROM breadth.sector_daily
  WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM breadth.sector_daily)
),
latest_stage AS (
  SELECT sector, COUNT(*) AS stage2_count
  FROM scores.stage_snapshots
  WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
  AND stage = 'STAGE_2'
  GROUP BY sector
)
SELECT lb.sector, lb.pct_above_50dma, lb.change_5d, ls.stage2_count
FROM latest_breadth lb
JOIN latest_stage ls ON lb.sector = ls.sector
ORDER BY ls.stage2_count DESC, lb.change_5d DESC
LIMIT 10;

synthesis_guidance: ['Summarize sector performance in terms of breadth and stage 2 participation.', 'Identify sectors showing the most improvement.', 'List candidate stocks to be added to TradingView based on research-only insights.']
